Titles, companies, locations, stated experience and description text are unedited apart from truncation to 5000 characters. The label on each row was assigned by reading the listing, including its stated years of experience, rather than by pattern-matching its title. Note two artefacts of real data that are deliberately preserved: Ashby's API returns no company name, so the board slug is used and can differ from the employer named in the text; and Remote OK returns a truncated teaser plus an anti-spam instruction, which is why those rows are low-evidence by nature.

labels.adjacent: Right role family and within the candidate's configured experience tolerance, but a stack she does not have or a bar slightly above her. Must stay eligible; excluded from precision and recall because either ranking is defensible.
labels.senior: Clearly above a fresher. Must not reach the high band.
labels.support: Customer or IT support rather than software engineering. Must not reach the high band.
labels.irrelevant: A different discipline entirely. Must not reach the high band.
labels.adversarial: Unsuitable but surface-similar: shares a generic title token such as 'Engineer', an Indian location, an 'Associate' level, or a profile skill mentioned only in passing. These rows are the reason this dataset exists.
labels.edge: Tests honesty about missing or unusable evidence rather than ranking.
labels.preference_mismatch: Right role family, but excluded by one of the candidate's own hard preferences: onsite in a city she has not accepted while not open to relocation, or an employment type she has not accepted. Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

We’re looking for an experienced Total Rewards leader to build and own Ashby’s total rewards function through our next phase of growth.

This is a builder’s role. Some of the foundation is in place; a lot of it isn’t. You’ll set the philosophy, design the frameworks, build the infrastructure, and run the work day to day. It’s a chance to shape how a company rewards its people rather than administer decisions someone else made.

It’s also unusually analytical, and unusually creative. Ashby’s Total Rewards philosophy is principled and intentionally not one-size-fits-all: approaches vary by function, because different parts of the business compete in different talent markets. Total Rewards partners closely with leadership to provide the structure, documentation, guidance, and governance that keep those approaches equitable, competitive, and scalable. The upshot is that the most interesting problems here don’t have off-the-shelf answers. How do you price a role that survey data doesn’t cover? How do you keep a flexible system fair and explainable? How do you tell, early, that one talent market has moved while the others haven’t? You’ll need real fluency with data, the discipline to structure a problem before you solve it, and the confidence to invent the model when no model exists.

A lot of this work looks less like administering a program and more like a well-run strategy engagement: frame the question, get the data, build the model, pressure-test the answer, and bring leaders a recommendation with the tradeoffs made explicit. The difference is that here you also go implement it.

You’ll partner closely with People Ops, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and functional leaders to design programs that support how Ashby attracts, retains, and rewards exceptional people — building a more scalable approach while preserving the flexibility each part of the business needs.

We’re looking for someone who has built and scaled Total Rewards in high-growth, VC-backed SaaS companies and is energized by all three of philosophy, systems, and execution — someone who would rather go build the analysis than wait for it.

This role starts as an individual contributor and is expected to grow into people management as the function scales.




YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Building Ashby’s compensation infrastructure

Bands, leveling alignment, market positioning, review cadences, benchmarking methodology, and clear guidance for offers, promotions, refreshers, and market adjustments — globally, and in partnership with founders, executives, and functional leaders. Some areas are mature; others are still forming. You’ll bring structure to the ambiguity with frameworks that are principled, practical, and hold up under scrutiny. You will be responsible for helping leaders reason through tradeoffs, bringing them a clear recommendation and the logic behind it, and documenting the non-standard rather than handing anyone a rule book.

Reading the market and helping Ashby adapt quickly

Combine market data, internal data, and outside signals to allow us to respond quickly and at scale when conditions change. Build the mechanisms that catch market movement across the whole company, not just the functions with the loudest signals: find the gaps in survey coverage, spot which teams are repricing faster than others, form a view on why, and turn what you see into a recommendation.

Owning Total Rewards strategy end-to-end

Compensation, equity, benefits, and perks. With founders and company leaders, define the philosophy, principles, and long-term direction for how we reward people globally. Evaluate our programs continuously and make recommendations that balance market competitiveness, internal equity, business needs, and long-term sustainability — framed the way a good strategy memo is framed: the options, the tradeoffs, and where you land.

record.title: Software Engineer, Integrations Platform, Vanta For Government (V4G)
record.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



Our Software Engineers build and own high-value products for our customers and the infrastructure that lets our business scale.



Vanta's team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it's essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to scale with our business. As a Software Engineer, you'll build and own full-stack features and platform primitives across our stack, work closely with the teams and partners who depend on what you ship, and grow into broader technical ownership. Your work will directly accelerate Vanta's growth.



Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We're growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.



Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on!



The Integrations Platform team within Vanta Government Cloud mission is to power the world's largest trust automation ecosystem, enabling any person or agent to build, connect, and automate trust seamlessly.



Federal compliance is going through its biggest shift in a decade and this team builds the integration platform underneath Vanta Government Cloud that turns federal frameworks into automated, continuously monitored product experiences. This is a builder role: you'll turn federal control requirements into the platform primitives and integrations that make continuous authorization real.



We own Vanta's integration ecosystem within the US Government Cloud, which currently includes a growing set of integrations across Cloud Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), Identity Providers, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS). In this role, you'll build, own, support, and scale Vanta's Government Cloud integration operations. You'll build upon and extend the Integrations Platform, which includes shared primitives for authentication, lifecycle, observability, and publishing so that all integrations are built on the same foundation. Our North Star is to eliminate the barrier to building integrations entirely, enabling anyone to create an integration in minutes using declarative, low-code, and no-code patterns, supercharged by AI agents.



What you’ll do as a Software Engineer at Vanta:

 - Design, build, and own full-stack features and platform primitives that internal teams, partners, and customers build on.

 - Deploy, operate, support, and maintain integrations running in Vanta's Government Cloud, including monitoring, on-call / incident response, and change management within the GovCloud boundary.

 - Contribute to our authentication, data-ingestion, and schema-evolution services, keeping integrations with external systems secure and reliable.

 - Partner with federal subject-matter experts to implement and maintain continuous-monitoring detectors and automated tests, with versioned framework mappings.

 - Build secure, well-documented, scalable services and UI with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

 - Improve performance, operational excellence, and SDLC practices within the team.

 - Use AI tools and workflows to accelerate development and operations.



How to be successful in this role:

 - 6+ years of full-stack development building reliable, scalable, fault-tolerant systems.

 - Platform and API design: you've built APIs and reusable components others depend on, with a solid grounding in RESTful APIs, authentication protocols (OAuth, API keys, JWT), and security best practices.

 - Data integrations: you've built data ingestion from external systems (Cloud Providers, HRIS, Identity Providers, Code Repositories) using best practices like rate limiting, retries and idempotency, and webhooks.

 - Systems thinking: you design for scale, reliability, and failure modes. You look around corners, address edge cases, and proactively identify and address risk.

 - Collaboration: you partner with internal teams, Federal agencies employees, vendors, and Third-Party Assessment Organization (3PAOs) to achieve mutual success. You incorporate their feedback into your designs, and are on a clear trajectory to broader technical ownership.

 - Interest in security or compliance: you're motivated by building trustworthy systems in a regulated environment.

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.
